title: Name the Main and Discovery flows across the router, the contract, and the README
action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1-D4 (docs/history/two-flows/CONTEXT.md) exactly; match each file's voice; add no new sections beyond what is named here. (1) skills/bee-hive/SKILL.md 'Route': lead the section with a two-door table naming the two flows — Main flow (idea to ship: bee-shaping, bee-planning, bee-swarming, bee-capturing, with bee-reviewing and the uat door at merge) and Discovery flow (an open question to a locked decision: bee-wayfinding is the spine; research, spike, and grilling are how its tickets resolve; exit is bee-shaping's Lock consuming the map's D-IDs). State the D4 override on its own line: an explicit user word — wayfinding, brainstorm, discuss, discovery, in any language — routes straight into the Discovery flow and skips the classification. Do not redraw the existing ASCII chain. (4) Run the regen chain in this cell: bee dev regen (this also regenerates the AGENTS block hash), then bee dev release-manifest --write. One commit, imperative subject, cell id trailer.
